primary_metric_definition: Pooled ROC AUC over all VALIDATE cells (window, outcome Up/Down, second 0..299 of the window); label = any of GF/XM/DS has an on-chain BUY OrderFilled (taker or maker role) on that outcome token with block timestamp in that second; score = frozen point-in-time model using only public data available before the second (Binance 1-s closes of second <= s-2, other traders' prints <= s-1, listing metadata), no own-state features.

split.note: BUILD may be extended back in time in later iterations

hypotheses.description: Fixed-size BUY limit orders priced at the current best ask; unfilled remainder rests at that price
Independent resting bids (inventory-balanced MM around a fair value)
hypotheses.verdict: open: 62% of maker fill events come from pure resting orders whose placement time is unobserved

hypotheses.description: Buys outcome o right after a Binance move toward o (1-3 s)
hypotheses.verdict: supported as the main timing signal; weak alone

hypotheses.description: Buy when Binance FV - ask > theta
Strike = 60-s TWAP before the open (vs open price)
Three wallets are parallel instances on the same signal
LightGBM on Binance-only PIT features, BUILD 14 days

hypotheses.family: behaviour cloning, spot + others' tape PIT
hypotheses.description: LightGBM on Binance + other traders' tape PIT features (cluster prints and prints against the cluster removed), BUILD = windows with tapes 10-09..16
hypotheses.verdict: best: presence AUC 0.892 (taker 0.893, maker 0.867); ~0.06 from 1-2 s race co-occurrence; side 66% < 80%; PnL corr 0.31 < 0.5

hypotheses.description: Does the bot act before public signals?
hypotheses.verdict: acts after Binance moves (2-3 s before block ts); faster feeds (Binance futures, Coinbase) untested

hypotheses.description: Pure resting orders are 'buy at the ask' orders that lost the race to a competing taker
hypotheses.verdict: supported: one trigger and one order type for both roles

hypotheses.description: Spot+tape model plus cluster window inventory up to s-1
hypotheses.verdict: small gain (+0.014); reported as secondary only

data_sources: Polygon V2 OrderFilled logs, topic2=cluster (own orders), 2026-10-02..H, 719,604 logs (.cache/re/btc5m-bot/chain/own)
Polygon V2 OrderFilled logs, topic3=cluster (makers hit by cluster taker orders), VALIDATE (.cache/re/btc5m-bot/chain/hit)
data-api taker tapes: all 2,016 VALIDATE windows + BUILD windows 2026-10-09..16 (partial)
